routing.title: Routing
routing.waveThreshold: Move wave steps off a platform at
routing.waveThresholdDescription: A wave's steps run unattended and several at once against the same allowance, so they leave earlier than your own chats do. Below this much of a window spent, a step prefers the next model down its ranking — and says so on its chip.
routing.chatThreshold: Move your own chats off a platform at
routing.chatThresholdDescription: You are in front of a chat and can react, so it may run closer to a limit than a wave step.
routing.classesDescription: Which models each class of work prefers, in order. A wave step can name its class, and an agent with no list of its own uses its role's class — so changing the order here changes what runs, without editing a single agent.
routing.reset: Reset routing to the built-in settings
